headline: America250 Plans July 4 Concert in L.A., Competing With Trump
context: The nonprofit, established by Congress a decade ago and separate from President Trump’s Freedom 250, will bring Smashing Pumpkins and other acts to Los Angeles on July 4.

sources.name: The New York Times
